points.title: S + be + thought/said/believed + to VR/have + p.p..... 被認為/據說/據信
examples: A high-sugar diet is generally believed to be harmful to our health.
LeBron James is thought to be one of the greatest players ever and surely to earn his honor in the NBA Hall of Fame.
Dinosaurs are said to have become extinct about 65 million years ago.

points.title: would rather…than…/would…rather than 寧願...也不...
examples: The general would rather die a meaningful death than live a meaningless life.
